item.title: Meta told to pay $375M for misleading users over child safety
item.description:
📝 "The jury found that Meta was responsible for violating New Mexico's Unfair Practices Act because it misled the public about the safety of its platforms for young users. Meta argued that it has worked over the years to combat problem users of its platforms and promote safe experiences for minors. New Mexico sued Meta in 2023, claiming the company "steered" young users to content that was sexually explicit, showed child sexual abuse, or even exposed them to solicitation of such material and sex trafficking.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cql75dn07n2o
